status_values.not_started: No implementation work has been verified in this repository.
status_values.in_progress: Work has started but the stated result is not yet verified.
status_values.blocked: A named external decision or dependency prevents progress.
status_values.done: Implementation and relevant acceptance checks have passed.
status_values.deferred: Outside P0; schedule only after pilot evidence and a separate scope decision.

status_note: The repository contains specifications and a mockup, but no verified product implementation. All P0 implementation tasks start as not_started; later-scope tasks start as deferred. Update statuses from evidence, not from the existence of a design or mockup.
priority_note: P0 is the initial release. P1/P2 items are explicitly outside its release gate.

tasks.title: Record P0 scope and acceptance map
tasks.description: Create a requirements trace linking each PRD section, AC-01–AC-20, MCP-01–MCP-12, and design P01–P45 to implementation and verification. Keep excluded features out of P0.

tasks.title: Resolve audience and privacy decisions
tasks.description: Assign decision owners and record pilot countries, learner age range, minor/guardian process or adult-only restriction, author onboarding, support operator, and incident escalation before recruitment or launch.

tasks.title: Select providers and deployment budget
tasks.description: Record architecture decisions for authentication, transactional email, approved video providers, relational database, object storage, durable queue, deployment, Python runtime, isolation technology, pilot capacity, and infrastructure cost.

tasks.title: Define retention and ownership policy
tasks.description: Approve retention, export, deletion, backup expiry, and sole-owner transfer/archive procedure for accounts, drafts, attempts, media, tokens, invitations, logs, and local caches; define restore re-deletion handling.

tasks.title: Set up modular application and environments
tasks.description: Create reproducible local, test, staging, and production configuration; separate web/API from execution workers; document secrets, migrations, deployment, rollback, and deterministic nonproduction fixtures.

tasks.title: Implement shared data model and migrations
tasks.description: Model users/capabilities, courses/drafts/immutable versions, versioned nodes and assessments, enrollments, invitations, code drafts, jobs, attempts, progress/waivers, media/uploads, reports, audit, author tokens, agent receipts, and recovery revisions with constraints and indexes.

tasks.title: Build common authorization and pagination
tasks.description: Centralize server-side ownership, capability, enrollment, version, and media checks; use safe unknown-resource responses and server pagination for courses, rosters, attempts, audit, and activity.

tasks.title: Build tokens, themes, and typography
tasks.description: Implement canonical dark/light semantic color and syntax tokens, dark-first first paint, Dark/Light/System preference, type scale, spacing, geometry, wordmark, icons, and motion/reduced-motion rules; check rendered contrast.

tasks.title: Build reusable shells and responsive navigation
tasks.description: Implement public, account, app, learning, author, and admin shells with the specified menus, mode switch, outline/tree behavior, breakpoints, workspace minimum widths, and safe mobile guidance.

tasks.title: Build accessible shared components
tasks.description: Implement buttons, forms, tabs, lesson rail, content tree, course rows, progress, tables, status/save indicators, drawers, dialogs, toasts, error panels, code blocks, and report form with keyboard and focus behavior.

tasks.title: Implement universal state contract
tasks.description: Provide loading, refresh, empty, no-match, validation, denied, not-found, offline, save failure, stale revision, rate limit, queued/running, service error, success, archived, suspended, and revoked states without painting protected content early or clearing recoverable input.

tasks.title: Implement safe routes and overlay transitions
tasks.description: Define P01–P45 route contracts and reusable routing/overlay behavior for safe URL filters, Back navigation, focus-managed confirmations, conflict comparison, and account-scoped return destinations; keep secrets and code out of URLs and analytics.

stages.name: Phase A — prove safe practice
stages.gate: Isolated Run/Submit, hidden-output protection, idempotency, reconnect, malicious-code tests, and code recovery pass.

tasks.title: Implement sign-up and email verification
tasks.description: Build verified-email account creation, resend/cooldown, expired-link recovery, restricted-pilot eligibility, safe invitation context, and P05–P06 states; enrollment and authoring require verification.

tasks.title: Implement sign-in, sessions, and sign-out
tasks.description: Build P04 sign-in, session expiry, safe return destinations, sign-out/all-device revocation, account suspension enforcement, authentication rate limits, and stronger admin authentication.

tasks.title: Implement password recovery and security settings
tasks.description: Build generic recovery responses, expiring reset flow, password/provider controls, reauthentication, admin stronger-auth state, and P07/P19 error and confirmation states without account enumeration.

tasks.title: Implement profile and appearance settings
tasks.description: Build P17 display-name save and verified-email view plus P18 theme, editor font size, and indentation preference persistence with truthful failure handling.

tasks.title: Implement privacy request intake
tasks.description: Build P20 export/deletion request submission, status, consequence dialog, and sole-owner blocker; route requests to an audited manual support process until completion automation exists.

tasks.title: Enforce safe access states
tasks.description: Provide P42 unknown, signed-out, revoked, suspended, offline, execution-disabled, and outage presentations; deny guessed private IDs and protected media across APIs and pages.

tasks.title: Define Python exercise and comparator
tasks.description: Implement single-file pinned Python 3 stdin/stdout assessment revisions, public/hidden tests, private reference solution, limits, UTF-8 validation, fixed line-ending/trailing-whitespace comparator, and immutable grading snapshots.

tasks.title: Build isolated execution workers
tasks.description: Run each test in a fresh sandbox outside the API with no secrets, network, host filesystem, child processes, or cross-job state; enforce CPU, wall, memory, disk, output, source, and test-size limits; destroy sandboxes after every outcome.

tasks.title: Build durable jobs and result lifecycle
tasks.description: Queue accepted work, lease/recover jobs, authenticate worker results, persist QUEUED/RUNNING/one terminal verdict, handle crash/retry and total timeout, reject duplicates/late results, expose polling/reconnect and stable execution IDs.

tasks.title: Implement Run samples and custom input
tasks.description: Run public tests or one custom stdin with short-lived records and bounded safe output. Keep sample/custom success separate from assessed pass and never update completion.

tasks.title: Implement Submit and protected grading
tasks.description: Accept exact editor-code snapshots with idempotency keys; grade public then hidden tests in order; persist attempts and authoritative progress atomically or repair idempotently; redact all hidden inputs, expected/actual output, stderr, identifiers, and timing from student paths.

tasks.title: Apply quotas and overload controls
tasks.description: Enforce per-account Run/Submit rates, two active jobs per user, fair bounded queue, provider-independent admission, retry guidance, author-wide validation quotas, and operator kill switch that leaves reading/saving available.

tasks.title: Build code draft persistence and recovery
tasks.description: Autosave code after 1–2 seconds by student/enrollment/version/step; acknowledge revision, preserve account-scoped local edits offline, resolve cross-tab conflicts, clear local cache on sign-out, and restore acknowledged code across devices.

tasks.title: Build desktop Python workspace
tasks.description: Implement P15 paired problem/editor/results layout, resizable keyboard-operable panels, syntax/indent/brackets/line numbers/undo/search/shortcuts/theme/font controls, Run mode, Submit, hints, status reconnect, public/hidden/infrastructure feedback, and desktop guidance on compact devices.

tasks.title: Build attempt history and restore
tasks.description: Implement paginated P16 attempt list/detail with immutable code, timestamp, verdict, runtime, infrastructure flag, protected diagnostics, read-only teacher variant, and confirmed Restore to editor without modifying history.

tasks.title: Validate runner isolation and reliability
tasks.description: Run adversarial networking/file/process/output tests, hidden-input echo leakage checks, Unicode/comparator cases, worker crash and timeout recovery, idempotency/reconnect checks, and document an isolation review before Phase A exit.

stages.name: Phase B — author-to-student delivery
stages.gate: An author creates, validates, previews, and publishes a mixed lesson; an invited learner enrolls, completes it, and resumes without staff database changes.

tasks.title: Create and list owned course drafts
tasks.description: Build P21 owned-course filters and title-only creation of a private draft; enforce one owner, additive author capability, owner-only drafts, and accurate unpublished-change/student-count states.

tasks.title: Implement course metadata and delivery settings
tasks.description: Build P31 basics, existing primary category, up to five normalized tags, difficulty, language, outcomes, prerequisites, approximate duration, and separate draft metadata from explicitly applied live visibility/enrollment controls.

tasks.title: Build builder tree and structure operations
tasks.description: Build P22 course/module/lesson/step selection, add/rename/duplicate/delete/collapse/reorder/move, drag and keyboard controls, 1–20 published steps per lesson, stable IDs, child-scope confirmation, and replacement instead of published step type mutation.

tasks.title: Implement canonical rich content and Markdown
tasks.description: Support required rich blocks and the documented safe Markdown subset through one canonical representation; sanitize paste/import, reject unsafe HTML/URIs, preserve Unicode, tables, code fences, image refs and alt/captions on editor/MCP round trips, and warn on unsupported export blocks.

tasks.title: Build image upload and asset processing
tasks.description: Support upload/paste/preview/replace, PNG/JPEG/WebP checks, size/dimension/decompression limits, processing/quarantine states, alt/decorative/caption metadata, object storage, authorized delivery, stable references, and version-aware retention.

tasks.title: Build Theory author editor
tasks.description: Implement P23 title, formatting/insert controls, image metadata/processing placeholders, required flag and estimated duration, safe content validation, autosave, and student-equivalent preview.

tasks.title: Build Video author editor
tasks.description: Implement P23 approved-provider URL validation, title, embed preview, verified captions or transcript, duration, failure recovery, and provider privacy guidance; do not add native upload.

tasks.title: Build Quiz author editor and server assessment
tasks.description: Implement P24 rich prompt, 2–8 options, single/multiple choice answer-key constraints, safe type conversion, post-pass explanation, server-side exact-set grading, unlimited abuse-bounded attempts, and no pre-pass answer-key payload.

tasks.title: Build Python exercise author editor
tasks.description: Implement P25 Problem/Code/Tests/Validation tabs for input/output format, constraints, starter, private reference, public/hidden tests, 0–3 hints, post-pass explanation, runtime and limit bounds, and protected author diagnostics.

tasks.title: Implement author autosave and conflict recovery
tasks.description: Save after about one idle second; show acknowledged revision and Saving/Saved/Not saved states, recover local changes, warn on unsynchronized navigation, detect cross-tab/server revision conflicts, and never silently overwrite newer content.

tasks.title: Build true student preview
tasks.description: Render draft Theory, Video, Quiz, and Python through P26 student components with persistent preview banner and return to selected step; exclude hidden tests/reference code and all enrollment/progress/product-analytics writes.

tasks.title: Validate exact draft and reference solutions
tasks.description: Check metadata, hierarchy, required steps, media accessibility/readiness, quiz keys, and Python public+hidden tests; run private reference against every test and invalidate validation when grading inputs change; return linked errors and warnings.

tasks.title: Build review and publication transaction
tasks.description: Build P27 blocking/warning review, save/revision state, impact statement, exact-revision publish action, atomic immutable version creation and latest-pointer swap, duplicate-click idempotency, stale-revision revalidation, and release receipt.

tasks.title: Pin enrollments and preserve old releases
tasks.description: Assign latest version only to new enrollments; keep existing students' nodes, tests, assets, progress denominator, and attempts pinned; expose version labels in roster/analytics; forbid in-place published type/grading changes.

tasks.title: Implement archive, restore, delete-draft, and suspension
tasks.description: Separate owner archive from admin suspension; block new joins on archive while active learners continue, block learning/execution on suspension, restore last release correctly, and delete only never-published drafts with confirmation.

tasks.title: Implement visibility and enrollment policy
tasks.description: Enforce public/unlisted/private discovery and open/invitation-only joining independently; make private invitation-only, exclude unlisted from search/indexing, protect course bodies until enrollment, and preserve existing access when policies change.

tasks.title: Implement enrollment lifecycle
tasks.description: Make eligible joins idempotent; support Active/Left/Revoked, retained progress, policy-based rejoin, explicit owner reinstatement, and atomic state checks so revoked users cannot rejoin via open links.

tasks.title: Implement email and link invitations
tasks.description: Build P08/P28 single-use email invites bound to verified address with seven-day expiry, shareable links with expiry/use limit, cryptographic tokens/digests, atomic consumption, resend/regenerate/revoke, delivery failure path, and safe invalid/mismatch states.

tasks.title: Build learning progress service
tasks.description: Record explicit Theory/Video completion, correct Quiz pass, Python server pass, optional-step state, last visited step, timestamps, and course completion; count only satisfied required steps, floor incomplete percentages, preserve earlier passes after failures, and handle waivers separately.

tasks.title: Build Continue and My courses pages
tasks.description: Implement P09 dominant resume and P10 in-progress/completed/previous enrollment lists, accurate next-step fallback, archive/suspension states, leave confirmation, and responsive rows.

tasks.title: Build enrolled overview and lesson navigation
tasks.description: Implement P11 pinned-version syllabus, lesson rail, required/optional/waived status, course completion summary, free step navigation, version label, progress count, and resume/review action.

tasks.title: Build Theory and Video steps
tasks.description: Implement P12/P13 reading content, authorized image delivery, accessible code blocks, transcript/captions, failed-embed recovery, outline and previous/next navigation, Report issue, and explicit Mark complete action.

tasks.title: Build Quiz step
tasks.description: Implement P14 single/multiple selection, server Check answer, no pre-pass key leakage, retry feedback, post-pass answer/explanation, durable attempts, and continued practice without reversing completion.

tasks.title: Verify mixed-lesson vertical slice
tasks.description: Exercise title-only course creation through theory/video/quiz/Python authoring, reference validation, preview, publish, invitation, enrollment, completion, resume, version update, and no staff database intervention.

stages.name: P0 extension — external AI authoring through MCP
stages.gate: A real SDK client creates and edits a course with Markdown, an uploaded image, quiz, and validated Python exercise, resolves a builder conflict, and publishes using an explicitly granted token; MCP-01–MCP-12 pass.

tasks.title: Implement scoped author token lifecycle
tasks.description: Issue tokens only to reauthenticated active verified authors; use at least 256-bit secrets stored as digest plus lookup ID, one-time reveal, 1–90-day expiry, immediate revocation, last use, and access loss on suspension/capability/ownership change.

tasks.title: Enforce course restrictions and operation scopes
tasks.description: Implement Read only, Draft authoring, Full course control, and custom scope grants; selected-course/all-owned restrictions, separate courses:create, created-course allowlisting, no self-expansion, and permission recheck before commit.

tasks.title: Build AI connections settings
tasks.description: Implement P43 list/filter/detail, creation grant summary, reauthentication, masked one-time secret/copy, replacement with same-or-narrower grant, revocation confirmation, expired/revoked history, and safe token-free instrumentation.

tasks.title: Build client setup and verification
tasks.description: Implement P44 real endpoint/transport instructions, tested compatibility matrix, generic bearer guide, optional environment-token adapter, honest OAuth-only limitation, safe placeholder examples, and last observed authenticated context check rather than false connected status.

tasks.title: Implement authenticated Streamable HTTP MCP
tasks.description: Expose /mcp via the official SDK, test supported protocol revisions and real clients, require HTTPS outside loopback, validate Host/Origin/content type/request size, and publish read-only schema/Markdown/connection resources.

tasks.title: Implement author context and course reads
tasks.description: Provide get_author_context, list_courses, and get_course with scoped ownership, pagination and metadata/outline/full projections, size budgets, protected assessment-data policy, and no cross-author search.

tasks.title: Implement course and structure mutations
tasks.description: Provide create/update course, module, lesson, and step plus move_content, duplicate_content, and delete_content using the same domain services and validation as the UI; enforce hierarchy, stable IDs, expected revisions, child-deletion intent, and protected published history.

tasks.title: Implement MCP image workflow
tasks.description: Provide bounded create/complete upload, get/update image, attach/detach tools; validate actual bytes/checksum/MIME/dimensions, never forward author bearer tokens to storage, resolve stable zur-asset references, and enforce course ownership/readiness.

tasks.title: Implement assessment validation and publication tools
tasks.description: Provide validate_exercise/get_validation, validate_course, and exact-revision publish_course through the existing isolated runner and publication transaction; honor exercises:validate/courses:publish and block invalid reference solutions.

tasks.title: Implement access and lifecycle tools
tasks.description: Provide set_course_access, archive_course, restore_course, and delete_draft_course as separate scoped operations with effect summaries and existing-enrollment/version protections; never hide live actions in draft batches.

tasks.title: Implement idempotent batch authoring
tasks.description: Require idempotency keys and expected_revision; return stable receipts for same retries and reject different payload reuse; implement prepare/apply atomic batches with temp IDs, 100-operation/1-MiB limits, digest-bound short-lived plans, and conflict recheck.

tasks.title: Enforce MCP security and quotas
tasks.description: Check token, author, scope, ownership, parents, assets, and restrictions per request/commit; redact secrets and rich payloads from logs; apply per-token calls, author concurrency/storage/runner limits and safe domain/protocol errors; expose no arbitrary shell, fetch, or filesystem tool.

tasks.title: Record safe agent mutation activity
tasks.description: Store token ID, author, label, tool, affected IDs, prior/new revision, outcome, time, and correlation ID; provide list_agent_activity/get_change with scoped, paginated, secret-free summaries and protected content diffs.

tasks.title: Implement draft revision recovery
tasks.description: Keep recoverable draft revisions at least 30 days under approved policy; implement restore_draft_revision with expected revision and actual-effect scope checks, creating a new draft without rolling back published versions, access, or learner records.

tasks.title: Build agent activity and builder update UI
tasks.description: Implement P45 filters, receipt/diff drawer, recovery review and conflict states; show remote update attribution in builder without overriding local save status, preserve unsynced edits, and handle deleted selected nodes safely.

tasks.title: Verify MCP end to end and adversarial cases
tasks.description: Run MCP-01–MCP-12 with a real SDK client, including cross-author IDs, restricted scopes, pending-write revocation, stale/repeated batches, unsafe Markdown/images, UI/MCP round trips, recovery, invalid reference, and unsupported OAuth-only client messaging.

stages.name: Phase C — discovery, teaching, and operations
stages.gate: All P0 acceptance criteria, accessible core journeys, privacy decisions, load targets, monitoring, and backup/rollback exercises pass in a controlled pilot.

tasks.title: Build landing page
tasks.description: Implement P01 public shell, accurate example workspace, Explore/authoring links, Read–Try–Check explanation, responsive layout, and signed-in Continue action without fabricated metrics or unsupported claims.

tasks.title: Build catalog, search, and filters
tasks.description: Implement P02 paginated public-only search over title/description/tags/author, category/level/language filters, safe URL query state, mobile filter sheet, consistent ordering/relevance, and no-result/retry states.

tasks.title: Build public and unlisted course overview
tasks.description: Implement P03 metadata, outcomes, prerequisites, informational syllabus, and state-specific enroll/sign-in/verify/invite/continue actions without leaking step bodies or private course existence.

tasks.title: Build help, reporting entry, and policies
tasks.description: Implement P40 accessible help and external support contact, contextual report entry, and P41 approved Privacy/Terms pages with effective dates; block launch on placeholder legal content.

tasks.title: Build owner roster and invitations view
tasks.description: Implement P28 paginated course-only search/status/version filters, enrollment state and last activity, invite tabs, email/link management, revoke/reinstate confirmations, and no unnecessary email exposure.

tasks.title: Build student detail for course owner
tasks.description: Implement P29 pinned-version step progress, completion/waivers, last activity, and submitted assessment/code history with owner authorization; omit unsent drafts, IPs, other courses, and unrelated profile data.

tasks.title: Compute and display exact course metrics
tasks.description: Implement P30 active and learning-active counts, completion, average required progress, distinct-student exercise pass rate, median attempts to first pass, last activity, window/version filters, denominators, waiver/infrastructure exclusions, and sparse-data states.

tasks.title: Implement privacy-safe product analytics
tasks.description: Record creation, publication, accepted enrollment, completion, run, submission result, hint reveal, and course completion with pseudonymous IDs and version metadata; exclude code, tests, tokens, email, free text, staff, previews, and automated checks from product KPIs.

tasks.title: Build operations overview
tasks.description: Implement P32 real execution, queue, runner, report, and email health with timestamps and incident links; render unavailable telemetry honestly and avoid fake healthy states.

tasks.title: Build user administration and audited support access
tasks.description: Implement P33 search/filter/detail, author grant/revoke, account suspend/restore, privacy-request status, stronger admin auth, reason-gated learner-record access, visible support banner, and audit events.

tasks.title: Build course administration and completion waiver
tasks.description: Implement P34 course lookup, suspension/restore and reports; add reasoned exact-version/step/affected-enrollment waiver with reviewed count, learner notice, distinct progress provenance, and no passing-attempt credit.

tasks.title: Build category administration
tasks.description: Implement P35 create/edit and normalized duplicate checks, usage counts, rename effects, and prevention of in-use category removal without reassignment.

tasks.title: Implement private report workflow
tasks.description: Accept broken-exercise/inappropriate-content reports with automatic course/version/step context, optional consented code, Open/Investigating/Resolved status, private admin P36 triage and resolution outcome, and support reference.

tasks.title: Build media operations
tasks.description: Implement P37 asset processing/quarantine list, authorized safe preview, owner/reference counts, review reason and impact, and retained-version deletion protection.

tasks.title: Build execution operations and kill switch
tasks.description: Implement P38 queue/worker/job health, time filters, paginated payload-safe records, explicit disable/reactivate new execution, audited confirmation, and confirmed backend state.

tasks.title: Build audit search and sensitive-action trail
tasks.description: Record and expose P39 paginated actor/action/target/time/reason/correlation search for admin, support, access, waiver, and agent mutations; redact credentials, code, hidden tests, signed URLs, and secret payloads.

tasks.title: Fulfill export and deletion requests
tasks.description: Implement audited manual support execution for account export/deletion, ownership blocker resolution, active-data purge within the approved policy, backup re-deletion marker, and user-visible request status.

tasks.title: Verify accessibility across core journeys
tasks.description: Test WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, keyboard/screen reader flow, focus, dialogs, tree/splitters/editor escape, live regions, text alternatives, reduced motion, forced colors, 200% zoom, and 320px reflow for enrollment, learning, coding, authoring, admin, and MCP settings.
tasks.blocker: Manual screen-reader and complete live keyboard journey verification require a human assistive-technology session; this environment has no screen-reader application/operator.

tasks.title: Verify responsive design and adverse states
tasks.description: Capture and inspect design checkpoints at 1440×900, 1024×768, 768×1024, 390×844, 320px and 200% zoom; cover both themes, long content, offline/unsaved, errors, queue, blocked publish, expired invites, suspension, sparse metrics, and token/recovery states.
tasks.blocker: Current captures cover representative breakpoints and states; the full page/state/theme matrix remains outstanding.

tasks.title: Implement monitoring, alerts, and operational recovery
tasks.description: Monitor queue age/stuck jobs, runner limits/failures, autosave, auth, email, and authorization denials with safe correlation IDs; set alerts, backup/restore, deployment rollback, runner shutdown, and documented incident playbooks.
tasks.blocker: External alert delivery and staging drills for backup restore, rollback, runner shutdown, and incident recovery require deployment infrastructure that is not configured.

tasks.title: Validate pilot load and reliability targets
tasks.description: Measure 100 concurrent learners and 20 execution requests/second for five minutes against reference exercises; record hardware/distribution/failures and evaluate p95 page/API/save/queue/grading targets, 99.5% availability plan, RPO/RTO, fair overload, and preservation of acknowledged writes.
tasks.blocker: The required isolated pilot environment, agreed baseline device/network, 100 dedicated sessions, and production-like runner are unavailable; no target load run or reliability claim is recorded.

tasks.title: Execute PRD acceptance matrix
tasks.description: Verify AC-01–AC-20 and MCP-01–MCP-12 with reproducible evidence covering private access, autosave, publication, invitations, Run/Submit, hidden data, code recovery, version pinning, progress, runner safety, accessibility, waivers, deletion, and agent authoring.

tasks.title: Audit page and state completeness
tasks.description: Verify design P01–P45 and S1–S6 are implemented or explicitly recorded as incomplete; inspect shared overlays, all universal states, dark/light themes, no dead controls, and no excluded promotional placeholders.

tasks.title: Run author and student pilot
tasks.description: Have invited authors publish prepared mixed lessons and learners practice/return; measure author activation, first-lesson time, student activation, week-two retention, grading reliability, and acknowledged-work loss with sample sizes/windows and staff/test exclusions.

tasks.title: Review security, privacy, and launch approvals
tasks.description: Review authorization, isolated execution, MCP grants, media, age/country eligibility, approved policies, retention/deletion, support ownership, backup/rollback, incident response, and pilot evidence; record unresolved blockers before public launch.

modules.name: P1 candidates requiring evidence and acceptance design

tasks.title: Design enrollment version migration
tasks.description: After pilot evidence, define explicit learner-safe mapping of old to new steps, assessment/progress effects, teacher controls, consent/notification, and acceptance before implementation.

tasks.title: Evaluate expanded assessment and editor features
tasks.description: Prioritize function-style exercises, short answers, partial credit/custom checkers, formula rendering, browser-local execution, advanced language services, and improved diagnostic guidance only against observed need and defined grading rules.

tasks.title: Evaluate richer author and roster tools
tasks.description: Assess co-authors, reusable question bank, whole-course duplication, roster bulk import/CSV export, intervention workflows, cohorts, scheduling, deadlines, and prerequisite locks with measurable pilot problems.

tasks.title: Evaluate broader identity and MCP compatibility
tasks.description: Assess social sign-in, institutional SSO, and standards-compliant MCP OAuth discovery/authorization for clients that cannot configure bearer tokens; do not represent the P0 token flow as OAuth.

tasks.title: Evaluate expanded media and learning surfaces
tasks.description: Assess native video upload/transcoding, arbitrary attachments, and mobile coding only if demand and processing/accessibility/security costs justify a separate scoped design.

tasks.title: Reassess excluded product areas only by new PRD
tasks.description: Payments, certificates, revenue sharing, native apps, live classes, messaging/forums, gamification, plagiarism detection, multiple languages, AI grading/tutors/autocomplete, SCORM/LTI, and organization permissions require a new product decision and specification; none are P0 tasks.
